basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Research Associate III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Research Associate-III post is open on a contractual basis for the Technical Resource Center under the Centre for Evidence for Guidelines at AIIMS New Delhi (अ.भा.आ.सं., नई दिल्ली). The post offers monthly emoluments of Rs 67,000 plus HRA (as per DHR guidelines) for a tenure of one year, starting with an initial appointment of three months that is extendable subsequently. Candidates need a PhD/MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or an MVSc/M.Pharma/ME/M.Tech, with 3 years of relevant experience, and must email their application to [email protected] by 17 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the Research Associate-III post is as per DHR guidelines. The notice does not print a numerical limit or a cut-off date for age. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

qualification.details: Candidates must hold one of the following: | PhD/MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree OR MVSc/M.Pharma/ME/M.Tech

how_to_apply: Interested candidates must send their application by email to [email protected] on or before 17 November 2026. The notice asks candidates to mention their phone number while submitting the application, because interview details are shared over email or phone. The notice does not name a subject line, an application format or a list of documents to attach.
important_instructions: For any queries, contact [email protected]. Interview communication will be sent preferably by email, so candidates should give an email address and phone number they check regularly.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS New Delhi Research Associate -III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (A.I.I.M.S.), New Delhi
Technical Resource Center under the Centre for Evidence for Guidelines
One Year (initial appointment of three months, extendable subsequently)
Rs 67,000 per month + HRA (As per DHR guidelines)

content_sections.heading: About the Technical Resource Center
content_sections.text: The post is in the Technical Resource Center, which works under the Centre for Evidence for Guidelines at AIIMS New Delhi. The notice is signed by Dr. Sachit Anand, Associate Professor, Department of Paediatric Surgery, A.I.I.M.S., New Delhi-29, and the appointment is made on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold one of the following: PhD/MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree OR MVSc/M.Pharma/ME/M.Tech 3 years of research / teaching and design & development experience, with at least one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Experience of conducting and writing Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis (minimum two published systematic reviews as lead author) Knowledge about GRADE methodology Experience in Statistics and Epidemiology Background in research Excellent manuscript writing skills and computer literacy Multi-tasking personality The age limit for the Research Associate-III post is as per DHR guidelines. The notice does not print a numerical limit or a cut-off date for age. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate-III receives monthly emoluments of Rs 67,000, with HRA paid in addition, as per DHR guidelines. The appointment is on a contractual basis for one year: the initial appointment is for three months and is extendable subsequently.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Research Associate -III
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must send their application by email to [email protected] on or before 17 November 2026. The notice asks candidates to mention their phone number while submitting the application, because interview details are shared over email or phone. The notice does not name a subject line, an application format or a list of documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview/virtual interview. The time and venue of the interview will be communicated to the candidates over email (preferably) or phone. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: For any queries, contact [email protected] . Interview communication will be sent preferably by email, so candidates should give an email address and phone number they check regularly.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the AIIMS New Delhi Research Associate-III recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 01 Research Associate-III post in the Technical Resource Center under the Centre for Evidence for Guidelines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: The last date for applying is 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the AIIMS Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: A PhD/MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or an MVSc/M.Pharma/ME/M.Tech, with 3 years of research / teaching and design & development experience and at least one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: The age limit is as per DHR guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the AIIMS Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs 67,000 + HRA, as per DHR guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs 67,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to the monthly emoluments of Rs 67,000, as per DHR guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the AIIMS Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: Email your application to [email protected] by 17 November 2026 and mention your phone number in it.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview/virtual interview, with the time and venue communicated over email (preferably) or phone.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS Research Associate-III job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on a contractual basis for one year, with an initial appointment of three months that is extendable subsequently.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.
